mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id AND ur.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.keep_alive, m.status FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id AND ur.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort, m.id
